name: Contextual Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the context of the conversation, including maintaining the topic and providing appropriate content.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Engagement Factor
description: Assesses the response's ability to engage the conversation partner, either by adding new information, asking questions, or expanding on the topic.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not engaging at all and 5 is highly engaging.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and consistency of the response, ensuring it makes sense within itself and in the context of the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not coherent at all and 5 is highly coherent.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response, looking at how it introduces interesting or novel ideas.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not creative at all and 5 is highly creative.

name: Relevance of Facts
description: Assesses the appropriateness and accuracy of any factual information included in the response, ensuring it is pertinent to the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not relevant or accurate at all and 5 is highly relevant and accurate.
